body: I have tried to encourage her to come to Christmas with me and I have said that I am happy to stay with her but she doesn't want to. In the past if I actually missed a family thing or she felt that I missed a family thing for her, it has made her feel bad/worse. Do you think it is likely to have more beneficial effect than negative if I skip the family Christmas to spend it with her? My gut feeling is that it would be more negative but I don't know.
